𝔓pos.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, and assume the standing `ProofData` assumptions for parameters $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, a complex-valued kernel $K : X\times X\to\mathbb C$, integer-valued scale functions $\sigma_1,\sigma_2 : X\to\mathbb Z$ and sets $F,G\subseteq X$ (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space), together with a tile structure for $Q$ with the default parameters $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)$, $\kappa=\mathrm{default}\kappa(a)$, $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$ and base point $o=\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$. Definition: a set of tiles $\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ (`𝔓pos`). According to its docstring, this is the set $\mathfrak P_{G\setminus G'}$ in the blueprint.

lintegral_carlesonSum_𝔓₁_compl_le_sum_li.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, and assume the standing `ProofData` assumptions for parameters $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, a complex-valued kernel $K : X\times X\to\mathbb C$, integer-valued scale functions $\sigma_1,\sigma_2 : X\to\mathbb Z$ and sets $F,G\subseteq X$ (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space), together with a tile structure for $Q$ with the default parameters $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)$, $\kappa=\mathrm{default}\kappa(a)$, $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$ and base point $o=\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$. Let $f : X\to\mathbb C$ be measurable. Then, with all integrals being lower Lebesgue integrals over $G\setminus G'$ of extended norms (values in $[0,\infty]$), $\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}$ denoting `𝔓pos`, $N := \mathrm{max}\mathfrak C(X)$ (`maxℭ X`), $Z := \mathrm{defaultZ}(a)$, and all summation indices natural numbers, $$\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_1^c, f)(x)\|\,dx \le \mathrm{(i)}+\mathrm{(ii)}+\mathrm{(iii)}+\mathrm{(iv)},$$ where (i) $=\sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{l<n}\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\cap\mathfrak P_1^c\cap\mathfrak L_0'(k,n,l), f)(x)\|\,dx$; (ii) $=\sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{j\le 2n+3}\sum_{l\le Z(n+1)}\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\cap\mathfrak P_1^c\cap\mathfrak L_1(k,n,j,l), f)(x)\|\,dx$; (iii) $=\sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{j\le 2n+3}\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\cap\mathfrak P_1^c\cap\mathfrak L_2(k,n,j), f)(x)\|\,dx$; (iv) $=\sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{j\le 2n+3}\sum_{l\le Z(n+1)}\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\cap\mathfrak P_1^c\cap\mathfrak L_3(k,n,j,l), f)(x)\|\,dx$. (Per the docstring, the subsets of $\mathfrak P$ appearing on the right are all antichains by design.)
